[h2][b]What's in The Pilgrim Pack?[/b][/h2] 
[h3][b]The Full Pilgrim Comic Story and Bonus Pages![/b][/h3]

Get ready to discover the world of Cult of the Lamb as you’ve never seen it before, as you set off for a perilous adventure with Jalala and Rinor across the Lands of the Old Faith!

Uncover mysteries, dodge dangerous Cultists looking for their next sacrifice, and mysterious mushroom peddlers... but watch out. For there are rumours of a wicked beast who stalks the land, searching for their next victim...

Watch the below video, to get a little taste of the comic, lovingly illustrated and written by our artist Carles Dalmau, and Head of Narrative, Jojo Zhou. 

[previewyoutube=d2D3BvgHmps;full][h3][/h3][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: † The Return of CTHULHU †
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/44104b7ba353f59d50cb80222022f0ca02c4b6ec.png[/img]
[h3][b]The Unholy Return of Cthulhu [/b][/h3]

Cultists, we have gathered your delicious devotion and prayers over the last 2 years. 

As a special unholy birthday blessing, we have brought back [b]Cthulhu[/b], for all those who missed out on the pre-order bonus long ago...

You will find this cheeky little fellow upon returning to your Cult grounds, all wrapped up pretty in a woolly gift box, alongside 3 special anniversary decorations - Flower Cart, Prayer Box and the Stone Candle Lamp. We can't wait to see your cult of cute Cthulhu's worshipping the Lamb! 

Make sure your game is fully up to date, Cthulhu and decor will be available in-game as soon as your system clock hits August 16th! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/be9867b14b6fb733e8210ee4ed799450781922fc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/93c30b6b745565d1547dafc1c4ff28133aae05b5.png[/img]

[h3][b]Merch Pre-Orders Now Live! [/b][/h3]
In case you missed it amongst the noise of Unholy Alliance, we also dropped new merch for pre-order, including OG Lamb Plushie! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/49ff1d0f89b1b3bdc027da5b455c9f292456a874.png[/img]

[b]New Plushies! Lamb, Goat, Ratau [/b]
3 precious beings. Fluffy Lamb and Grumpy Goat, ready for your hellish night-time cuddles! Even Ratau has made an appearance, here to guide you on your journey to become the greatest cult leader in all the Lands. You would never do anything to hurt him... would you?

[b]Coexist Longsleeve T-Shirt and Duality of Lamb Blanket[/b]
On the one hand there is growth and life; on the other decay and death. Embody the universal balance between Lamb and Goat. 

[b]New Pins, Purple Crown and Goat [/b]
To celebrate the launch of this update - The Goatest of all Time! 

[url=https://merch.devolverdigital.co/]Shop them on the Devolver Digital Store, linked here. [/url]

Thank you for all of your support by purchasing our DLC's and merch - this helps us to keep creating even more cool and exciting content for Cult of the Lamb! 

[h3][b]Bug Fixing[/b][/h3]
Thank you for all of your feedback following our latest update! We have been going through your bug reports and feedback since, and our team are hard at work on squashing those bugs. 

There are a few widespread issues like unlocking The Goat Fleece we're aware of - I'm happy to share we're working on a fix for that, but we'll also be adding a change to make it more easily accessible much earlier in the game! 

Thank you for all of your patience as we continue to work through all of your reports, of varying bugs - we will update here as soon as we're ready to push a patch out!

notes.title: † Major FREE Update UNHOLY ALLIANCE Out Now! †
notes.content:
[h1]Unholy Alliance, our next FREE major content update, is now available to play! [/h1]

Today, we're announcing the release of our next free major content update, as well as our new Pilgrim Pack DLC! 

[previewyoutube=rjeyYMuGZgU;full][/previewyoutube]
As well as the addition of co-op play, the Unholy Alliance expansion also adds new tarot cards, relics, buildings, fleeces, Follower traits, Follower quests, and other secrets to discover! 

[b]To play all the new content, make sure your game is fully updated. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1313140/view/6191967063109587748]For a TLDR; summary, see the patch notes here. [/url][/b]

We have also launched The Pilgrim Pack! This DLC consists of a brand new interactive digital comic, where your choices will take you on a colourful adventure! Alongside adding in new secret quests, Follower forms, outfits and decorations for your beloved Cult.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2890190/Cult_of_the_Lamb_Pilgrim_Pack/

[h2]Friends Who Slay Together, Stay Together: Local Co-op[/h2]

Summoned by blood, and born in corruption. The Goat is a wicked new ally that can join the holy Lamb in [b]LOCAL CO-OP[/b]! Experience the entire Cult of the Lamb campaign, with one player inhabiting the role of the Lamb and the other taking on the mantle of the Goat! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/af07ba916bb16841467c877e01d72e0ed70a5bb8.gif[/img]

[b]How to Start Co-op Play[/b]
Simply plug in or connect a controller if you're playing on the same PC, and configure co-op in the pause menu to get started. 

Steam Remote Play is also enabled for those of you who are further away from each other - please note that you may run into issues with this, if both players are using a keyboard due to how Remote Play is set up. For best results without having to use a work around, please have at least 1 player using a controller. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/bc86a9a62ce7d231e841b2d881c0e51a6566651e.gif[/img]

Enjoy new ways to interact with the world of Cult together - from fishing to cult chores and knucklebones, plus much more! Choose from a selection of corrupted weapons, tarot cards, curses, and relics as you embark on co-op crusades together to defeat all who stand in your way. 

[h2]The Final Bishop Questline[/h2]
You have defeated them - now it is time to truly make them a part of your Cult. 

10 in-game days after the Bishop relic quests, a Bishop will return to you with a quest. Complete these to cleanse them, unlock a new trait, and for a final reward from Narinder. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/945a46e3a48d341d5df88d7da724d4cd33eb86a0.gif[/img]

[h2]21 New Traits For Your Followers[/h2]
This update brings with it a whopping [b]21 NEW traits[/b] for you to expand your Cult following with! 

[b]Jerk Follower Change[/b]
We heard you loud and clear, these Followers are meant to be annoying, but not THIS annoying! To remove the 'Jerk' trait, you can either reassure, or bully them into submission. We'll leave the choice up to you... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/d975f7b587cfea37828de9c8a51b15d011c06bab.gif[/img]

[b]Poet[/b]
Followers with this trait will never work, and instead choose to sit near the edge of the base, crafting poetry all day, with some special lines unique to each major boss you defeat. Make sure you have defeated the first boss to unlock this trait! 

[b]Cursed[/b]
Followers may acquire this grisly trait after being resurrected! They cannot perform any tasks, and have limited interactions. Cure them through the Medical Bay, or.. you know.. just let 'em be. What's the worse that could happen?

[b]Community Requested Traits! Pettable, Polyamorous[/b]
Now you can shower love on ALL your Followers, no matter what they look like! Followers with the 'Pettable' trait will have the 'Pet' action in their radial wheels. Followers with the 'Polyamorous' trait will not be jealous if the Lamb gets married to other Followers.

[b]...Plus, 17 other new traits![/b]
Spy, Nightowl, Snorer, Drowsy, Catatonic, Inspired/Excited/Disturbed by Mission, Unlawful, Reformed/Scarred/ Hardened Criminal, Unhappily/Happily Married, Proud/Overwhelmed Parent, and Murderously Jealous Spouse. Phew!

[h2]Knucklebones Table & Nursery[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/860cbe6f1e16614dd870e21ccad973e580fb2556.gif[/img]

[b]Nursery Building[/b]
You may assign up to three babies in the Nursery, and you can build as many as you like. Babies placed in the Nursery will not be able to escape baby jail until they become adults. This is available in the Divine Inspiration Menu. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/cde0b7d9d0f16aad8b883efb8eb0a805dfffee89.gif[/img]

[b]Knucklebones Building [/b]
This single build structure will allow you to play one match a day against a Follower of your choosing. Difficulty will be based on their Follower level - win the match to level them up instantly. Fun fact: you can also play against The Goat/Player 2! Defeat all of the Knucklebones gang at Ratau's place to get this table. 

[h2]New Fleeces, and Transmog System[/h2]

[b]New Fleeces[/b]
[b]The Goat Fleece[/b], unlocked in the Crown Menu once you unlock corrupted Relics and Tarots, will allow players to play as The Goat in single player!

Small update note: If that doesn't work, please try enabling co-op once, then checking the Crown Menu. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/adf5c33cbb5394f0d0d2a3d6eabaddeff18e7a47.gif[/img]

[i]You've Yee'd your last 'Haw.[/i] [b]The Cowboy Fleece[/b] allows players to don a shiny Sherriff's star, and play as Cowboy Lamb - with a special bleat animation to boot, too! This is available after the unlocking the Blunderbuss, and allows players to start with this weapon during runs. 

[b]Fleece Transmog System[/b]
Pressing the 'Custom Appearance' button on a fleece will allow you to assign the visual fleece design of your choice, while keeping the selected fleece's traits. This feature can be found in the Crown menu, and is available once you unlock at least one fleece. [i]Though be warned, this feature is not available on purely cosmetic fleeces. [/i]

[h2][b]New Relics & Tarots! [/b][/h2]
New varieties of Relics and Tarots have been added in this update for more fun - whether you're playing solo or with a friend! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/a768ae0532989ae0bf32d536fc53c0cbf03c9077.gif[/img]

[b]Blessed & Damned Relics[/b]
These are variants that add either a further positive, or negative effect to existing relics. 

While Blessed Relics will have a more 'heavenly' effect (such as blue hearts), Damned Relics will have a more 'hellish' effect (such as diseased hearts). Corrupted Relics have both a negative and positive effect (for example, taking damage whilst damaging all enemies).  

[b]5 new Co-op Relics[/b] add more ways to strategize! Swap weapons, make your friend invincible, and more! These only drop in co-op mode. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/6b4bac884b536ad05262ff667f51b6ebb4cfb1dc.gif[/img]

New regular Tarots have been added for more fun! Pick 'Blind Wrath' to strike an enemy with lighting, or 'Usurper Blessed' to even heal fully when you enter the Boss room! 

[b]Corrupted Tarot Cards [/b]
With great power, comes cost. 'The Hoarder' will allow you to recover full health, at the cost of damage when you use relics. 'Blighted Core' will make all enemies take huge damage - at the cost of you taking double damage. 

[b]Co-op Tarot Cards [/b]
Because slaying with friends is more fun! Connect to each other through a damaging beam to run through your enemies, or even deal critical damage when you attack at the same time! 

[b]How to Unlock New Tarot Cards and Relics[/b]
Upon defeating the final boss, [spoiler]The One Who Waits[/spoiler], the next time you are defeated in a dungeon, a room will appear. Interact with the cursed totem in that room to unlock Corrupted Relics & Tarot Cards. New relics will automatically appear during crusades, or in the Mystic Seller's item pool. 

Co-op Tarot Cards and Relics will unlock upon adding a second player to the experience for the first time, and will only appear in crusades when Co-Op Mode is enabled. 

[h2]Force Weapon Mode[/h2]
Find this new feature in the Accessibility Settings! Toggling this will allow you to select the weapon you want to see appear on every weapon pedestal during runs. 

[h2]Twitch Integration[/h2]
We've made many changes to the Twitch Integration system with this update! 
[list]
[*] Completely reworked extension backend to improve stability and speed of all integration features
[*] Reworked follower customization flow: Viewers can now customize their follower on a per-channel basis beforehand! Entering and winning a raffle will now make them appear in-game immediately. Once their follower is in-game, they will no longer be able to customize it until the player loads a new save in which the viewer has no follower yet. 
[*] Viewers who have not customized their follower yet will not be able to enter the raffle
[*] Added support for playing a game of Knucklebones against Twitch chat
[*] More Help or Hinder options
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/bf29bfae0aaf6d9bfa26d37c412ff3fe8c0c75f4.png[/img]

This update is a love letter from us, to you - the community. From new structures, Bishop content to local co-op and more, this update has been about giving back to the Community who has always stood by us. While we always try our best to get your ideas and feedback in game, this update is a special shout out to YOU! 

We'd like to extend a huge thank you to everyone who has supported us and Cult of the Lamb so far. It's a dream come true to be able to work on a game with a fanbase as passionate as we have. 

It's not over yet! We're still working on more for Cult of the Lamb, and can't wait to share with you what is next.

Spy, Nightowl, Snorer, Drowsy, Catatonic, Inspired/Excited/Disturbed by Mission, Unlawful, Reformed/Scarred/ Hardened Criminal, Unhappily/Happily Married, Proud/Overwhelmed Parent, and Murderously Jealous Spouse.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.4.3 - Unholy Alliance
notes.content:
[h3]Small Update Note: If you cannot unlock The Goat Fleece in the Crown Menu by unlocking Corrupted Tarots/Relics, please try enabling co-op mode once, then navigating to the Crown Menu. We're aware of an issue that's making this Fleece not appear, bear with us while we investigate![/h3]

[h3]Please note that with Steam Remote Play, you may run into issues if both players are using a keyboard due to how Remote Play is set up. For best results without having to use a workaround, please have at least 1 player using a controller. Thank you![/h3]

[h1][b]Version 1.4.3 - Unholy Alliance Patch Notes[/b] [/h1]

[h3][b]New Features[/b][/h3]
Local Co-op
[list]
[*] Have a friend join you locally as The Goat and play Cult of the Lamb in Co-op!
[/list]
Buildings
[list]
[*] Nursery - Send baby followers to the nursery to look after them in a group.
[*] Knucklebones Table - Verse followers or a friend at the knucklebones table.
[/list]
Traits
[list]
[*] Poet - Never work and have no interactions; they will sit near the edge of the base, writing poetry all day.
[*] Unlawful - Has a small chance each phase to break out of prison, and can even break other followers out of prison.
[*] Snorer - Followers with the Snorer trait wake up followers who are sleeping nearby by snoring loudly at night. 
[*] Insomniac - Followers with the Insomniac trait sleep during the day and work at night. 
[*] Inspired by Mission - Followers with this trait will only have positive conversations with other followers.
[*] Excited by Mission - Followers with this trait will have higher mating chances after getting excited by their recent adventure.
[*] Disturbed by Mission - Followers with this trait will behave the same way as catatonic followers. Healing them will remove the trait.
[*] Polyamorous - Followers with this trait cannot get other wedding related traits upon getting married.
[*] Pettable - Followers with the Pettable trait can be pet regardless of their skin.
[*] Spy - Followers may join the cult by themselves with the Spy trait. Followers with this trait work and behave like any other followers and will leave the cult with 10% of gold after 5 days. 
[*] Reformed Criminal - Followers with this trait will be 10% more productive.
[*] Scarred Criminal - Followers with this trait will act like Coward followers.
[*] Hardened Criminal - Followers with this trait will act like Jerk followers.
[*] Happily Married - Followers with this trait will be 20% more productive.
[*] Unhappily Married - Followers with this trait will be 20% less productive.
[*] Jealous Spouse - Followers with this trait will keep fighting other spouses until they kill them.
[*] Murderous Spouse - Followers with this trait will keep fighting other spouses until they kill them. Followers with this trait always win fights.
[*] Cursed - Followers with this trait will not work and have limited interactions, they also eat other followers.
[*] Proud Parent - Proud parents have unique thoughts about their child and are able to hug them regardless of their age.
[*] Overwhelmed Parent - Overwhelmed parents will also have unique thoughts about their child, will generally look exhausted and will have more frequent negative conversations.
[*] Catatonic - Followers with this trait cannot perform any tasks and have limited interactions. 
[/list]
Fleeces
[list]
[*] Goat Fleece - The Goat fleece is a cosmetic fleece allowing players to play the goat in single player.
[*] Cowboy Fleece - The Cowboy fleece forces the player to use the Blunderbuss.
[*] Transmog System - Interchange the appearance and abilities of fleeces.
[/list]
Relics & Tarots
[list]
[*] Normal Relics - 12 normal new relics! 
[*] Corrupted Relics - 8 new corrupted relics! These relics grant some great powers, but come with a trade off.
[*] Co-op Relics - 5 Co-op relics that will only drop in Co-op!
[*] Tarot Cards
[*] Normal Tarot Cards - 9 new tarot cards!
[*] Corrupted Tarot Cards - 9 new corrupted tarot cards! These tarots grant some great powers, but come with a trade off.
[*] Co-op Tarot Cards - 5 Co-op tarot cards that will only drop in Co-op!
[/list]
Accessibility
[list]
[*] Force Weapon Mode - Choose a type of weapon to spawn at all times.
[/list]
New Misc Content
[list]
[*] Bishop Quests - Discover more lore about the Bishops in these new unique quests.
[*] Dungeon Encounters - All 4 dungeons have been populated with tons of new encounters.
[/list]
[h3][b]Fixes & Changes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed occasional softlock when equipping a relic
[*] Fixed hearts and other pickups spawning outside of dungeon rooms
[*] Fixed users not unlocking the Axolotl form after completing the lighthouse quest
[*] Fixed an edge case where Sozo’s questline did not progress
[*] Fixed followers receiving the Disciple trait once they reach max level without doing the Disciple Ritual
[*] And plenty more various bug fixes!
[*] Stopped disciples from stealing other follower beds
[*] Children and parents can no longer become lovers with one another
[*] Added twitch decorations to mystic seller items
[*] Jerk’s can be reassured and bullied. Reassuring will remove their jerk trait
[/list]
[h3][b]Twitch Extension[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Completely reworked extension backend to improve stability and speed of all integration features
[*] Reworked follower customization flow:
[*] Viewers can now customize their follower on a per-channel basis beforehand
[*] Entering and winning a raffle will now make them appear in-game immediately. Once their follower is in-game, they will no longer be able to customize it until the player loads a new save in which the viewer has no follower yet
[*] Viewers who have not customized their follower yet will not be able to enter the raffle
[*] Added support for playing a game of Knucklebones against Twitch chat
[*] More Help or Hinder options
[/list]
[h1][b]Pilgrim Pack - DLC Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

Pilgrim Comic
[list]
[*] Experience an adventure with Jalala and Rhinor in the digital Pilgrim Comic.
[*] Enjoy the animated comic or turn each page in Traditional Mode.
[/list]
Pilgrim Quest
[list]
[*] New quest line that will allow the player to recruit unique followers into their cult.
[*] Finish the questline to unlock the Bonus Comic Pages
[/list]
Bonus Comic
[list]
[*] Special pages written from the perspective of Jalala
[/list]
Pilgrim Content
[list]
[*] New Fleece: Fleece of the Silken Touch
[*] Two new follower outfits: Jalala's Coat, Rinor's Robes
[*] 5 new Follower forms: Panda, Skunk, Camel, Anteater, Echidna
[*] 5 new decorations: Bamboo Wall, Bonsai Tree, Hanging Lantern, Small Pagoda, Vase of Peonies 
[/list]

Continue to voice your suggestions and feedback to us in our [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/CultOfTheLamb/]Subreddit [/url]and [url=https://discord.com/invite/massivemonster]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Cultish Activities, Lesser Known Features, and a Wizard With a (Red Crown) Gun
notes.content:
[h3][b]Lesser Known Cult Features [/b][/h3]
Sins of the Flesh has been out for a little while now, and we're loving seeing you explore all the new aspects of the update! We're still hard at work bug fixing and are continuing to patch. Our patching cannot be contained ːTheDivineRedCrownː

We'd love to share some lesser known features that may improve your Cult experience! 

[h3][b]De-ageing Followers[/b][/h3]
By cracking an egg, you can make any elderly Follower young again! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/toP3aQz.gif[/img]

Just select the crack option on any egg, after successfully mating 2 Followers! Then proceed to the kitchen, where your Follower will don their chefs best to to cook an Egg Meal. Feed this to the Follower of your choice and watch them rediscover youth! Better than any ageing cream. 

[h3][b]Pause Cult Time While on Crusades[/b][/h3]
Navigate to the Settings menu, to select a number of options that will make crusading a breeze! There are also options to:
[list]
[*] Auto cook 
[*] Auto craft 
[*] Auto fish 
[*] Unlimited HP/Fervour
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/c4QW0ZO.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Community Contests[/b][/h3]
As you may know, we LOVE hosting community contests over in our Discord and Reddit! The Seal Form was the outcome of our 'Faction Wars' event over on Discord, where participants fought for the chance to have their Factions animal in game... look at that little face! ːTheRedCrownː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/173880619f47a328683fa45aa74f697d68d98cec.png[/img]

We recently ended our 'A Lambmas Carol' contest, with some fantastic art from artists all over the world! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SrQizb8.gif[/img]

Upcoming will be an AMA event, and a base building competition. Join the Cult on [url=https://discord.com/invite/massivemonster]Discord [/url]and [url=https://www.reddit.com/]Reddit [/url]to participate! 

[b]Cult of the Wizard With a Gun. We Love Casting Spells.[/b]
Encounter a cultish new costume and weapon in Wizard With a Gun! You can wear the Scytheman's Costume and wield 'The Red Crown' from for free, so long as you own both games on the same platform!

What collab would you like to see from us next?

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/37935/Cult_of_the_Lamb_x_Wizard_With_a_Gun/

[h3][b]What’s To Come[/b][/h3]
We're still continuing our work on bug fixing the issues you have brought to us. If you do come across them, in the first instance please report it in our pause menu, where we have linked our official bug reporting form! 

We are also listening to your feedback so far and will be implementing some changes - including increasing odds of finding the Meat Room in the next patch. 

To answer the question a lot of you have also been asking - yes, this isn't the end. We're also working on our next update, which will satisfy those of you who felt the Cult depth update wasn't your cup of tea. Keep reporting bugs, and letting us know your suggestions/feedback ahead of that update!

notes.title: A Small Update From Us, Post Sins of the Flesh!
notes.content:
Thank you so much for all of your love and support following the release of Sins of the Flesh! 

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1313140/announcements/detail/6915906760354008792]We packed this update FULL of new features, lore, Followers and rituals to satisfy your darkest desires[/url], and are so happy to finally see everyone's reactions and feedback. We're still working on bug fixes, so please bear with us while we do so! 

And for those who felt a little disappointed by the update focusing on Cult depth - not to worry! We're still working on more combat-y stuff for a future update. 

[h2][b]Have you met Poppy yet?[/b] [/h2]
Our Art Director Jimp sadly had to say goodbye to his darling dog Poppy last year. We're still sad, but Poppy lives on! We added her as a Follower in the latest update, so now everyone can know and share in the joys of cleaning up her poop!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/94d7c7c4fcca5c91a5d5797db9a0b80ba759defa.png[/img]

Find Poppy in Darkwood! And NO ONE IS ALLOWED TO DO ANYTHING BAD TO HER 😡

[h2][b]Cult Cheatsheet[/b][/h2]
If you're not sure how to unlock various aspects of Sins of the Flesh (including how to rescue Damned Followers, outfits, etc), [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1313140/discussions/0/4139438126591609685/]we have written up a guide here, in our Steam forums! [/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/029b60d29cc9e4e8f0fec5d464cd50eaf1f79f84.png[/img]

[h2][b]Devolver Digital Behind The Schemes[/b][/h2]
Ever wondered, "who are the devs behind Cult of the Lamb"? 

Check out our collab video with Devolver, where we talk about Cult of the Lamb, Sins of the Flesh, and what it's like to bathe several cats at once. 

[previewyoutube=QyK2vrrCDJ0;full][/previewyoutube]
[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/CultOfTheLamb/]We will be hosting an AMA on Reddit soon! Make sure to join us over on our Cult of the Lamb Subreddit, as we'll post there when it will happen! [/url]

[h2][b]The Sinful Pack[/b][/h2]
ICYMI, we have also dropped the Sinful Pack, a new cosmetic DLC! 

Extra fancy Follower forms, lustful decorations, and cheeky outfits - all this drip for a little extra, if you would like to help support the development of Cult of the Lamb (and feed some developers). 

Plus, you get a nudey Lamb Fleece! Who doesn't want that! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/5a2cfc51e0b73104acb2cfdd50c7e955489e9671.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2646130/Cult_of_the_Lamb_Sinful_Pack/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/4a418620d98dfcf25cbfb4efa400ea22ef15479b.png[/img]

notes.title: † Major FREE Content Update SINS OF THE FLESH Out Now! †
notes.content:
[h3]Our next major content update for Cult of the Lamb, Sins of the Flesh, is now live! This is one of our most feature filled, cheekiest updates yet bringing new features, rituals, buildings, fixes and much more - including the return of a much missed old friend... 🍄

[b]This is a completely free update that will download to your game automatically! [/b][/h3]

We have also released the [b]Sinful Pack[/b]! New Follower forms, lustful decorations, and cheeky outfits - all yours for a little extra, if you would like to help support the development of Cult of the Lamb. Check it out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2646130/Cult_of_the_Lamb_Sinful_Pack/]here[/url]! 

We have prepared a special deep dive into the Sins of the Flesh below! 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1313140/view/6915906760353923311][u][h3]Click here for the Patch Notes.[/h3][/u][/url]

[previewyoutube=dsCUA_VQ5Nw;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/5f0831afd9ae2842806f60f5d91dc4ebe7de13b0.png[/img]

[h2][b]New Features[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Sins and Disciples[/b][/h3]
[h3]Some rise by sin, and some by virtue fall. After defeating 3 Bishops (or if you are in post game), perform a Sermon, Doctrine or Ritual to unlock the new content! 
[/h3]

New progression systems add more depth and complexity to managing the Cult of the Lamb! By following the sinful path, your Followers will delight in gluttonous rituals, vain buildings, and 8 new wrathful doctrines. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/647afzf.gif[/img]

Followers can now generate a deliciously evil new resource, Sin, via rituals or building structures. Spend it on upgrading the Temple, removing the cooldown on purgatory, re-indoctrinating Followers and building shiny new structures!

[h3][b]New Rituals[/b] [/h3]
We have packed this update full of dark new rituals. Use them to lead your Followers into depravity, into the stinking mud of vile repudiation... and as a medium to harvest [b]SIN[/b]. 

Perform the [b]Rite of Lust[/b], and choose your favourite Follower to become the Mayflower Leader! This flower crown clad Follower will gladly generate Sin for you. Followers will not work for half a day, and will instead prance around nakey. Just an average day at the Massive Monster office. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5gAKbkz.gif[/img]

[i]Oh, to be an anatomically incorrect nude animal frolicking with nothing but a leaf and freedom to my name...[/i]

Perform the [b]Rite of Wrath[/b] - and watch Followers cause havoc! Choose your feistiest fellow to become the Wrath Leader. This Follower will chaotically generate Sin.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Dyx37Ox.gif[/img]

Or how about the [b]Gluttony of Cannibals[/b]? Choose an unlucky Follower to be consumed in their entirety by the others, generating Sin and an inescapable sense of guilt for yourself. Unless you don't mind, in which case, you're just as much of a monster as we are.  

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9wfhFEN.gif[/img]

If a Follower has Sinned too much, they will become consumed, and eventually damned. Perform [b]Sinner’s Pride[/b], and choose one sacrificial Follower to absolve all cult members of their Sin 🙏

To rescue Followers from their Damnation, find them during Crusades. They will seek you out, to destroy the cause of their suffering. Put an end to them three times during a Crusade, and revive them back at the Cult! If you can't find your Follower, try sorting the order by name. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tDrlaie.gif[/img]

[h3][b]The Inner Circle of True Believers[/b][/h3]
Invite your most loyal Followers to the inner circle of Disciples, a revamped levelling system of Follower progression. The [b]Discipleship Ritual[/b] will allow you to initiate a level 10 Follower, giving them the coveted position.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/EKSPRbt.gif[/img]

Upon initiation, Disciples gain the Faith Trait (allowing them to re-educate those naughty dissenting Followers once a day), and can generate more Devotion compared to regular Followers. Follower level is now capped at 10 - Followers at max level can still participate in any interactions or Cult events that would normally increase their loyalty, but their loyalty bar will not appear anymore.

Build the Disciple Collection Shrine so your most faithful can deposit devotion from other buildings into one central spot! The Disciple Boost Shrine allows Disciples to pray, and by filling up a shrine, give the Lamb a boost for the next crusade. 

[h3][b]Decadent New Structures[/b][/h3]
Sins of the Flesh comes with extra space in your Cult, and brand new structures! 

[b]The Drinkhouse[/b] 
Craft drinks at the Drinkhouse for your Followers! Once a Follower consumes their delicious little treat beverage, they will generate sweet, sweet Sin, at risk of becoming Befuddled. Followers will stumble around, puke, fight, chat, laugh, sing, and generally have a merry old time!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/utYUN4f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/4eb53fb4e89f73bd2abc9570814f53b37faa1b1a.png[/img]

If one of your beloved Followers finds themselves Injured from a particularly nasty scrap, they will limp around feeling sorry for themselves, until the 'Injured' state passes. 

[b]The Mating Tent [/b]

You asked for this. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Sw0hDEU.gif[/img]

When two Followers love each other very much, they may enter the tent, and find an egg afterwards... but what will hatch? Nurture the egg in the Hatchery, then care for the offspring until they're ready to pledge allegiance to your Cult!

✨ A Golden Egg may appear! Something special will hatch out of these!✨

[b]Maid Dresses?![/b]
Each of your cultists can flaunt their Follower fashion at the new Tailor building! Once unlocked, each cultist can wear their own outfit, with as many as 23 different snazzy styles to choose from. On your crusades you may find a new room, with a special NPC selling unique clothing! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mGQoNwv.gif[/img]

[b]Drum Circle[/b]
Put on a performance for your cult to enjoy, with a drum circle mini game for your chosen Follower to generate Sin! Perform well, the amount of Sin you receive depends on it. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OSSS8MC.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Upgrade the Temple![/b][/h3]
Decorate richly these halls of worship, so we may always be reminded of Their blessed presence.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/VY8oXj6.gif[/img] 

[h3][b]Would You Still Love Me if I Was a Worm?[/b] [/h3]
New Follower Skins have been added to this update - Lemur, Caterpillar, Seal, Snake, Worm and a Shaggy Dog (based on Poppy, our Art Director Jimp's beloved pal). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/d1fab921393b51e89900d137a035409927a2cbad.png[/img]

We've added a whopping 16 new traits for Followers, with varying effects such as increasing mating odds, producing Sin, and much more. 

Jerk Followers will jeer at the Lamb, while Hot Tempered Followers may try and scrap with other Followers. Scared Followers run away from the Lamb. Will you reassure them or bully them? [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1313140/view/6915906760353923311]Read about all the different types of traits in the patch notes here! [/url]

When you indoctrinate a new Follower, you will also find a new outfit and necklace assignment option on the indoctrination screen - a much requested feature!

[h3][b]More Lore! An Old Friend Returns[/b][/h3]

Learn even more about the Cultverse! There are now 15 Lore Tablets to collect across the game. These can be found once per crusade, within secret lore totems. Break these, and reveal truths unseen. 

In response to your wishes for more, we have also added an extension to our old menticide mad friend, Sozo's questline! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Fq6FPIe.gif[/img]

On your crusades, you may come across a familiar face from the past. Dissented Followers who left your cult may confront you - will you show them mercy?

[h3][b]Better Cult Life[/b] [/h3]
Shiny poop, baneful brooms, and bigger, better buildings improve busy Cult life! Shiny poops have special effects, like yielding fruitful crops and adding XP to your broom. 

Levelling up your broom will make chores faster and more effective! To improve automation, there’s also a new tier for the Janitor Station and the Seed/Fertilizer Storage Structures so your Followers will take better care of themselves! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/j3M8qTZ.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Speaking of Poop... [/b][/h3]
6 new types of poop! 
[list]
[*] Glow Poop - Attracts fireflies.
[*] Golden Poop - Drops gold when cleaned. Drops gold/gold bars when harvesting a crop fertilized with golden poop.
[*] Rainbow poop - Gives 5 times the chore XP when harvested. Instantly grows a crop when fertilized with rainbow poop.
[*] Devotion Poop - Generates devotion when cleaned. Crop fertilized with devotion poop will generate devotion over time.
[*] Massive Poop - Drops multiple poops when cleaned. Followers can get stuck in the massive poop :(
[*] Poop pet - Drops a poop pet when harvested, but only when the poop is from a Follower with the poop skin.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/875d7ffe628f37d95062fe22796561d895b896c9.png[/img]
[h3][b]Lamb With a Gun[/b][/h3]
Blast heretics away with the new Blunderbuss weapon! When loaded up, it fires big damage in close quarters to bring a new combat playstyle for your crusades. If you charge it up even more with a heavy attack, you can aim to snipe enemies from long range. Pew pew 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Xzuorzp.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Requested Changes & Improvements[/b] [/h3]
Thank you for all of your feedback following our prior updates! We have added some much requested features and fixes, not limited to but including: 
[list]
[*] You can now reindoctrinate and rename Followers! 
[*] A prompt to signify that sacrificing followers in certain locations are permanent. 
[*] Remove, hide and show necklace option. 
[*] You can now skip sermons. 
[*] Dissenters who have left the cult now have a chance to show up in the dungeon, and fight the Lamb!
[*] Auto levelling up followers after sermons and rituals.
[*] Six new achievements to collect. 
[*] Fixed demons not joining in the final fight.
[*] Fixed certain follower questlines
[*] Fixed Morgue and Crypt issues
[*] Fixed certain weapons not showing on crusades
[/list]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1313140/view/6915906760353923311]For the full list of changes and fixes, check the patch notes here. [/url]

[b]Twitch Integration [/b]

We added more Help/Hinder options for Twitch Integration! Plus, Viewers can now select an outfit in the Follower builder after they win a raffle. You can also use all of the integration’s features on your mobile devices!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/53062d894c38eecb3cc1078ade07f8b1b38f81fa.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/24393831b71da8c7cc39f9057130ad4e185c3180.png[/img]

[h1]Cult of the Lamb: Sinful Pack[/h1]
Vanity might be a sin, but these lil fellows don't seem to mind! 

Indulge in the gluttonous aesthetic befitting of royalty with new Follower forms, outfits, decorations and a sinful new Fleece for the Lamb in this new DLC! As an addition, we have also added 2 Tailor outfits for  those who own the Heretic Pack, and 2 Tailor outfits for those who own the Cultist Pack.

Hammerhead, Ladybug, Tiger, Llama or Sphynx - which will you invite into your Cult? 

[previewyoutube=e0J14QGhow0;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/134c76266555bf436f4f88b8cd7ab442b8d1161b.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2646130/Cult_of_the_Lamb_Sinful_Pack/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/44104b7ba353f59d50cb80222022f0ca02c4b6ec.png[/img]

[h1]Twitch Drop Gnomes Pea, Owe and Geeh[/h1]
These Gnomes will be publicly released at a later date, but you can get them early during this month's Twitch Drops campaign!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/7abdba9f704bc1087274bebe8c4af247073a2854.png[/img]
Drops end Tuesday, 30 January 2024!

[b]How to get the Gnome Twitch Drop: [/b]
You must watch a participating channel to receive progress towards the Drop. When you watch for the required amount of time, a claim message will appear at the top of the Twitch navigation, where you'll be directed to the Drops Inventory page to claim your reward. 

Because there are so many streamers, we can't list them all - if you head to Twitch and search who's streaming Cult of the Lamb, it mention in the stream title if Drops are enabled! 

[url=https://twitch.cultofthelamb.com/]Click here for more info! [/url] 

[h1]Merch Restock [/h1]
Your cries have been heard by the mighty Lamb God 🙏

We have dropped a HUGE merch restock, of almost every product! Beanies, T-Shirts, Pins, Prints, the elusive Long Lamb Pillow - you name it! 

Some are in-stock, whilst others will be available for pre-order (with expected shipping in May). [b]Items such as the Floofy Enamel Mug and Long Lamb Pillow have been restocked BUT with limited quantities, so snatch them up quick! [/b]

Check everything out on the [url=https://merch.devolverdigital.com/collections/cult-of-the-lamb]US Devolver Store[/url], or our [url=https://merch.devolverdigital.co/collections/cult-of-the-lamb]Global Store![/url] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/b6658e8921e5b8ea5945e5998ede22d5b9580aa0.png[/img]

[h1]A Message From Us [/h1]
Lastly, we'd just like to extend a huge thank you to everyone who has supported us and Cult of the Lamb so far. Cult of the Lamb has reached so many more people than we could have ever imagined, and it's a dream come true to be able to work on a game with a fanbase as passionate as we have. 

It's not over yet. We're still working on even more, and we can't wait for all of you loyal Cultists to see what's in store for the Lamb! 

[h3]Love and Devotion, 
Massive Monster [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/4a418620d98dfcf25cbfb4efa400ea22ef15479b.png[/img]

Continue to voice your suggestions and feedback to us in our [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/CultOfTheLamb/]Subreddit [/url]and [url=https://discord.com/invite/massivemonster]Discord[/url]! 

We are still hard at work on fixing lots of pesky bugs. If you do come across any issues, please report them in-game via the pause menu so we can investigate! 

[url=discord.com/invite/MassiveMonster][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/a1de6dfd1f0a97f680b6634004c01047748a9ac6.gif[/img][/url]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.3.2 - Sins of the Flesh
notes.content:
Greetings, Cultists! 

It's the moment you have been waiting for. The Sins of the Flesh Update is now live for Cult of the Lamb! This is one of our most feature filled, cheekiest updates yet. Sins of the Flesh brings new features, rituals, buildings, fixes and much more - including a much missed old friend. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1313140/view/6915906760354008791]We've prepared a special deep dive into the update here.[/url] If you're just after the patch notes straight up, find them below! 

[h1]Patch Notes 1.3.0 - Sins of the Flesh[/h1]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new weapon - the Blunderbuss! Lamb goes pew pew. 
[*] Added 6 new Achievements.
[*] Eggs - Followers can be hatched from eggs! Golden eggs will grant special skins.
[*] New Resources have been added. These include Grapes, Hops, Cotton, Silk Thread, and Yolk. 
[*] Extra Resource rooms
[*] New Follower skins - Lemur, Caterpillar, Seal, Snake, Worm. 
[*] Extension of the Sozo questline
[*] Sin Doctrine category (4 new choices, 8 new Doctrines)
[*] Auto levelling up followers after sermons and rituals.
[*] Rebuilding structures mini game.
[*] Shop room inside the dungeon with an NPC (Berith) that sells unique clothing.
[*] Re-indoctrination option on the indoctrination podium.
[*] Outfit and necklace assigning option on the indoctrination screen.
[*] Disciple ritual that turns level 10 followers into Disciples.
[*] Followers will now fight with one another, causing injuries and sometimes death.[/list]
[b]The Sin System[/b] 
[list]
[*] Followers generate sin which can be used as a new currency! Sin can be generated from specific Sin rituals and buildings. Spend it on upgrading the Temple, removing the cooldown on purgatory, re-indoctrinating followers and building structures.
[/list]
[b]New Rituals[/b]
[list]
[*] Rite of Lust - Followers will dance in their birthday suits around the shrine. Choose your favorite Follower to become the Mayflower Leader for half a day! This Follower will generate Sin. Followers will not work for half a day, instead they will prance around naked. 
[*] Rite of Wrath - Followers will cause havoc on the base! Choose a follower to become the Wrath Leader. This follower will generate Sin.
[*] Gluttony of Cannibals - Choose a follower to be consumed by others. This will generate Sin.
[*] Sinner’s Pride - Choose a follower to absorb the Sin of all followers.
[*] Discipleship - Choose a level 10 follower to become a Disciple, in your inner circle of true believers.
[/list]
[b]Buildings[/b]
[list]
[*] Drinkhouse - Craft drinks at the drinkhouse for your followers. Once a follower consumes their delicious little treat beverage, they will generate Sin. There is also chance to become Befuddled. They may need a little tactical spew to keep the festivities going. 
[*] Drinkhouse Level 2 - Queue more drinks.

notes.title: 'SINS OF THE FLESH' HATCHES ON JANUARY 16TH 🥚
notes.content:
[h1]Sins of the Flesh Update.

[b]JANUARY 16TH[/b]

You asked for it.[/h1]

In its biggest and most wicked content update yet, the Cult’s tendrils extend even further with a blasphemous beneficence of quests, features, improvements and a deliciously evil new resource that rewards those leaders prepared to yield to the [b][i]Sins of the Flesh[/i][/b].

[previewyoutube=l16yniS3VmU;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Sins and Disciples 🐍[/b]
New progression systems add more depth and complexity to managing the Cult of the Lamb. By following the sinful path, your followers will delight in gluttonous rituals, vain buildings, and wrathful doctrines. Invite your most loyal Followers to the inner circle of Disciples, a revamped levelling system of Follower progression.

[b]Better Cult Life 🧹[/b]
Shiny poop, baneful brooms, and bigger, better buildings improve busy Cult life. Shiny poops have special effects, like yielding fruitful crops and adding XP to your broom. Levelling up your broom will make chores faster and more effective. To improve automation, there’s also a new tier for the Janitor Station and the Storage Structures so your Followers will take better care of themselves.

[b]LAMB WITH A GUN 🔫[/b]
Blast heretics away with the new Blunderbuss weapon. When loaded, it fires big damage in close quarters to bring a new combat playstyle for your crusades. If you charge it up even more with a heavy attack, you can aim to snipe enemies from long range.

[b]Leshy in a Maid Dress??? 👗[/b]
Each of your cultists can flaunt their Follower fashion at the new Tailor building! Once unlocked, each cultist can wear their own outfit, with 23 different styles to choose from. But your Cult is getting even more unique. When two Followers love each other very much, they might find an [i]egg[/i]. Nurture the egg for it to hatch, then care for the offspring until they're ready to pledge allegiance to your Cult!

[b]Webber [/b]has made an appearance in Cult of the Lamb, and would love to join your cult!

[spoiler]When killing spiders at the base, there is a chance a skull will spawn. Bury this skull in a grave for the Webber Follower to appear! This Follower will have a trail of spidery friends following along behind. This new Follower form includes a sinister selection of variants too! [/spoiler]

To play this new mode, select it when starting a new game (just like the Permadeath mode!).

notes.title: Cult of the Lamb’s first Major Content Update is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[b]Relics of the Old Faith[/b] is an [i]ENORMOUS[/i] free update to Cult of the Lamb. We’ve listened to many of your requests and have been working since launch to add everything we possibly could. There’s so much that it can’t fit into one News post, but we’re going to try…
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/6c3e673901f9d816442450b618cc6ab8f0f822bc.gif[/img]

[h3]New Post-Game Storyline[/h3]
After defeating the final boss, a mysterious otherworldly being gives the Lamb a new task.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/c22b5e5655d77dc0747dc329ba3aa28b63436ab5.gif[/img]
[h3]Revamped Boss Fights and Enemies[/h3]
In the new Post-Game, every boss has been revamped with new and tougher attack patterns. We know many of you asked for more combat depth and difficulty, so this is just one of the ways we're adding your requests in Relics of the Old Faith.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/3db178a0ef3a887649c10e0c95ef6dbe527572da.gif[/img]
[h3]Post-Game Progression[/h3]
Crusading against these new challenges will also bring new rewards. The mystic seller will grant the Lamb many useful items that will allow you to mandate previously missed doctrines, grant new Follower abilities with necklaces and unlock new Follower forms!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/496a9898694306767476ee9fafcca3e251df4f2d.gif[/img]
[h3]Relics to Collect and Combat[/h3]
So what are these Relics of the Old Faith? Relics are an entirely new combat system that we've added for the Lamb to collect and combat. From the Eye of Leshy to Clauneck's Shoe, each of these ideological items will grant a powerful new ability for your crusades.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/646f61a43f51c8e40c902e8ab426692c2da1edde.gif[/img]
[h3]Chemach [/h3]
This curious character is the keeper of the Relics of the Old Faith. When you encounter them on your crusades, you’ll learn more about these mysterious items and their place in the world.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/3db20e23fa43960712525c8e366bf36c722cb4d6.gif[/img]
[h3]Heavy Attacks [/h3]
Each of the 5 weapon types now features a Heavy Attack. Throw your Axe like a boomerang, spawn a ranged assault of Daggers, or spin in a Gauntlet tornado to match whatever situation you find yourself in. Heavy attacks can be upgraded to an even stronger form. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/27eb28908d49bd787f46e58a011cbbc8d1081a2a.gif[/img]
[h3]It’s a (New) Trap![/h3]
The Lamb can’t be the only one with new ways to fight. Shielded enemies, moving rivers and swinging axes are a few of the new tricks in the heretics’ arsenal. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/1b61083388641bd6041a1cc6e90efd6aad3a19c6.gif[/img]
[h3]Purgatory and Challenge Runs[/h3]
In Purgatory, there are new crusading challenges like the Boss Rush and the Dungeon Gauntlet. With 5 new Fleeces and an added Permadeath mode, you can customize your very own combat experience. And yes, you can tackle the final boss fight on the same save file!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/6bc3aef68829e617d83866990345f78d5fd92630.gif[/img]
[h3]Surprises and Secrets[/h3]
During your crusades, you may encounter familiar friends and foes. What is Midas doing in Darkwood? Who’s causing beef between the Lighthouse Keeper and the Mushroomos? 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/0cb0b1d4f4264456fa04e0ab521f9a06cdf8abf0.gif[/img]
[h3]New Buildings for Better Cults[/h3]
Hollup, let them cook! We’ve added 5 new structures to help manage your Cult. Followers can cook in the Kitchen, have sleepovers in Shared Shelters, and organize their farms. The Crypt and the Morgue will also let you deal with pesky dying Followers more efficiently!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/b5eba7e11c4a2a05f79da527ee12109ef60e9f27.gif[/img]
[h3]Special Boss Followers[/h3]
The new Post-Game story will allow you to convert the 4 bishops as Followers! Maybe you’ll figure out how to get a few cute kitties to join you, too. This is along with 11 new Follower forms and 7 that were previously exclusive outside of the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/af922fda7a911969bfaf9286e291fec24d29fef6.gif[/img]
[h3]Photo Mode[/h3]
Photo Mode will give you a whole new point of view! Change the angle, zoom in, and decorate with 88 different stickers to make your own memories in your Cult and during crusades. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/3b5432e8caab49c34f53985735171effcd75fca8.gif[/img]
[h3]Playing Your Way with Accessibility[/h3]
You can now pause time at your Cult while you are crusading on a dungeon run! If you want to focus on the combat while your Followers stay healthy, this is the option for you. We’ve also added several new text options like dyslexic fonts in English, changing roman numerals to numbers and toggling high contrast text, text styling and the Build Mode filter. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/8cd9efac30b5fa5c58e70d28883499a0fdd8b887.gif[/img]
[h3]New Achievements and Collections[/h3]
For the completionists, we’ve introduced more achievements, tarot cards, quests, sermon upgrades and so much more! 

[h1]Heretic Pack[/h1]
[previewyoutube=8VDs24K8_xY;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2331540/Cult_of_the_Lamb_Heretic_Pack/

I think you can see that this update is truly enormous. We never expected that so many people would play our game and we’ve put as much as we possibly could into Relics of the Old Faith. 

We want to make Cult of the Lamb the best game it can be and that’s why this Major Content Update is entirely free. 

If you’d like to continue supporting us, we’ve released the Heretic Pack which is purely cosmetic DLC. We're also going to put the game on its [b]biggest sale yet[/b], so it’s the perfect time to join the Cult! 

You’ve shown us so much devotion so far and we are so happy that we can all enjoy this huge release together. 

This is for all of you,

[h3]Thank you[/h3]

[h1]Full Patch Notes - Version 1.2.0[/h1]

[h2]New Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new storyline which begins after completing the base game.
[*] Added 37 new Relics with various powers which must be collected by the player.
[*] All 5 Weapons got a new Heavy Attack and Level 2 Heavy Attack.
[*] Added new Sermon upgrades that unlock extra damage, Relics, Heavy Attacks, and a new ability to reroll your Weapons and Curses on Crusades.
[*] Added new Crusades, which are encountered after the base game.
[*] Added 13 new Encounters with various Characters and cutscenes.
[*] Added many new Combat rooms, with new traps such as rivers, swinging axes, etc.
[*] Added Fish, Meat, and Relic rooms.
[*] Added 6 new Enemies to fight in new Crusades.
[*] Added 16 new Minibosses to fight in new Crusades.
[*] Added 4 new Bishop transformations to fight in new Crusades.
[*] Added Chemach - a new Character who deals Relics.
[*] Added ??? - a new Character who provides quests and opens a shop that accepts God Tears.
[*] Added Forgotten Commandment Stones  - a new resource used to unlock Doctrines you didn’t choose in the past.

notes.title: Revealing new buildings in a major update coming soon!
notes.content:
[h3]Major Update Coming Soon[/h3]
Cult of the Lamb will be matching our [b]biggest sale this weekend[/b], with a whopping 25% off! If you’ve been sitting on the fence, now is the perfect time to pick up and play because we’re working on a [b]FREE Major Content Update, [i]Relics of the Old Faith[/i][/b]. This update will have new challenges, new combat abilities, and new ways to manage your Cult!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/3de10376ac649880141659238bc7d1dc2cea7957.gif[/img]

With the power of the Lamb on the rise and the Followers flocking, Cult management isn’t as easy as it once was… until now! [b]RELICS OF THE OLD FAITH[/b] will introduce new buildings to keep your Cult efficient, aesthetic, and growing, growing, growing.

[h3]Kitchen[/h3]
You’ve been a single Lamb, slaving away to feed your Followers for long enough - build a [b]Kitchen[/b] in your Cult, and assign a Cook to keep those hungry mouths fed! Queue up to 30 meals and let them cook.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/8cc54213dd41105042f2f262d77a41339bca1303.gif[/img]

[h3]Shared Shelter[/h3]
Praise our great Lamblord for solving our housing crisis! In a [b]Shared Shelter[/b], three Followers can share one roof that will never collapse.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/d03399c96b75d26095f4ed58b0a2840094447c78.gif[/img]

[h3]Crypt[/h3]
Lay multiple Followers to rest in their final and eternal sleepover with the introduction of the [b]Crypt[/b]! A way to keep graveyards small, and avoid those nasty rotting corpses while each upgrade stores more bodies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/b4ecf8705acbe64e3dda2865c0fb1668f3aa1961.gif[/img]

[h3]Organised Farming[/h3]
Love a well-tended garden? [b]Farm Plot Signs[/b] let your farming Followers organise your crops! Choose a certain crop for the sign and the Follower will plant those seeds around it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/17c414b36b0112b2c292894501d36986ede079e2.gif[/img]

[h3]Your Feedback Helps![/h3]
We’re working on these new structures based on your feedback. However, [b]they are only a small part of [i]Relics of the Old Faith[/i][/b]. An update that will primarily focus on adding more combat depth and endgame replayability! 

Here at Massive Monster, we’re committed to making Cult of the Lamb the best game it can be, with [b][i]Relics of the Old Faith[/i][/b] releasing soon, and a [b]second Major Content Update[/b] coming later this year. Thank you for keeping the Faith high, the Devotion flowing, and the Lamb crusading through the evolving world of The Lands of the Old Faith…

notes.title: Major Update and RELICS OF THE OLD FAITH
notes.content:
Happy New Year, devoted followers of the Lamb! And what better way to start the year than with some blessings in the form of an update to [i]Cult of the Lamb[/i]. Here’s a taster of what’s coming your way:

[b]Blessed be thy name.[/b]
Finger slip when you were naming your Cult? Or maybe it was funny at the time, but now not so much? Use your Book of Doctrines to rename your Cult anytime.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/6fe44c97af7a6faea7f35a42047e10c3fbb13bc9.gif[/img]

[b]Blessed be thy stats.[/b]
Your Book of Doctrines will also now display your statistics - your Crusades, Kills, Followers, and their fates. A great way to keep track of the holy history of the Lamb!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/a74905a87e87863c7ea562f3278566f2ec9e41db.gif[/img]

[b]Blessed be thy controller.[/b]
Some have a specific way to play - we hear you! Fully customise your controls for optimal heretic-slaying efficiency.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/9d5513413cffafae87c4bbd393c833102c903c74.gif[/img]

[b]Blessed be thy cooking… and fishing.[/b]
A successful Cult means a lot of mouths to feed! You will now be able to enable Auto-Cooking and Auto-Fishing from the Accessibility menu in Settings. That’s right, every dish and fish will be an automatic success!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/cacbaf3c594e1d5f94119069d71ed7dd16cdebb6.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/319f8ef3bf21ef365a7cba8311c0ddef8227c61a.gif[/img]

[b]Blessed be thy blessings.[/b]
We get it, you’re a busy Lamb, you don’t have time to Bless every. Single. Follower. Well, fret no more - the Lamb can now Bless, Inspire, or Intimidate multiple Followers at once within an area. You get a Blessing, you get a Blessing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/da847883228984fac4e2d47719b453148817e8f1.gif[/img]

These updates will help the Lamb navigate the changing Lands of the Old Faith in time for the release of our first FREE Major Content Update! That’s right, faithfully follow the Lamb into…

[h1]RELICS OF THE OLD FAITH[/h1]
[i]Coming early 2023[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/3de10376ac649880141659238bc7d1dc2cea7957.gif[/img]

Featuring new challenges, enemies, and ways to keep non-believers in line. There’s plenty to look forward to so Praise the Lamb and join us for [i]Relics of the Old Faith[/i].

And to keep the blessings rolling, we’ll have a second - that’s right, second! - Major Content Update coming mid-year, which will focus on adding depth and detail to your Cult management gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/cc0b52fb4c8350347b3ab7d756a378530ae44a2b.gif[/img]

Both of these free Major Content Updates appear on the [i]Roadmap[/i] which you can find on the title screen.

Thank you for your support, and we hope you enjoy crusading once more in [i]Relics of the Old Faith[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/a339bc901611b2fffcb5dee6fd8e12a19d93eb9c.gif[/img]

With love and devotion,

Massive Monster

notes.title: Sneak Peek of the first Cult MAJOR CONTENT UPDATE to celebrate our biggest sale!
notes.content:
[h1]Thank you for an amazing year[/h1]

After years of work, we released Cult of the Lamb in 2022. It has reached so many more people than we could have ever imagined and that's thanks to every single of one of you who have played and supported our little Lamb. 

We appreciate your loyalty to the Lamb and to say thank you, we're ending this year with the first reveal of our [b]FREE Major Content Update[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/38fe867894f7bcfbf7a6188677a02ba65a33cece.png[/img]

[h3]Holiday Specials[/h3]

Before we get to the new content, we wanted to share our Holiday Specials. To celebrate the season, Cult of the Lamb is currently on its [b]BIGGEST SALE EVER at 25%[/b] off here on Steam! 

We have also released two new Follower Forms, the Penguin and the Lion. These are available as Twitch Drops by watching participating streamers play the game until January 5. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/608053f25af6dcaa6f62d49b2b4e278743f66a6a.gif[/img]

And we have been nominated for Outstanding Visual Style in the Steam Awards. Vote! Vote! Vote!

It's the perfect time to dive into the Darkwood and find out what the little Lamb is all about with lots of new content around the corner.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/steamawards/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/248e79d45ac546ed29a14eada17596a23a0ed057.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Free Major Content Update - Sneak Preview[/h1]

Along with fixes and improvements, we have been working on adding more depth to the game. Based on your feedback, this major content update will focus on combat and dungeon gameplay. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/5b62caf5d733a991d6063f7b68c8d4041c79e2dc.gif[/img]

The Lamb has some new moves! Press and hold the attack button for a [b]HEAVY ATTACK[/b]! This new sword move can knock back many enemies in one SMASH when you're being swarmed. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/1a861e5957b59f9c810a6d8e974574a4868e11c9.gif[/img]

Each weapon type has its own [b]Heavy Attack[/b].  This Axe boomerang throw provides a ranged option. Charge the Axe throw to launch it in a straight line before it flies back to your new position, slicing enemies both ways. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/e87283f866a31bdec178c32518f6b70ca4e4e394.gif[/img]

The Dagger's [b]Heavy Attack[/b] spawns pain from the sky. Multiple Daggers will drop in a line and each of them will knock enemies farther away.

[h3]and so much more![/h3]

Adding a new attack to each weapon will give you more options in every encounter. However, we're also working on many other new features that will add depth, difficulty, accessibility and quality of life. We've been listening to your feedback and are addressing the most requested improvements in this free Major Content Update. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/89b089e9e459c884dd25d6ebd7f766c507397b04.gif[/img]

Can you spot anything different about Barbatos? There will be many good reasons to rematch against your favorite foes. 

We have another round of fixes scheduled for the very start of the New Year but after that, we will be working on this Major Content Update. It's A LOT so it will take more time in the cooking pot. 

We don't say this enough but thank you for enjoying our game. We hope you have a great New Year! 

[h3]Love and devotion from the Massive Monster team[/h3]
